notes.title: v3.0 - Rain and more
notes.content:
Your previously favorited fish will become unfavorited with this update as a result of some reworking of systems. Sorry for the inconvenience!

It might start raining sometimes at certain locations… Bite times are decreased during this time!
Added some new secret fish…
Favorites tab now has its own inventory size, separate from the other fish tab
A new upgrade for favorited fish inventory size has been added
Fish Inventory Size upgrade’s max level is increased
Max Bait Capacity upgrade’s max level is increased
Decreased cost of travelling to locations
Cost of various cosmetics has been decreased
Game icon has been updated
HD Font has been slightly adjusted
Window position/size information is no longer saved/loaded on Steam Cloud
Window will try to remain on-screen on game startup
Adjusted some fish sprites
Some small bug fixes


Thanks for playing <3

notes.title: v2.0
notes.content:
Changes:

Locations have been reworked:
Removed the Locations tab in the shop
A new UI element has been added to the bottom right to change locations
Locations no longer cost money to unlock. They are instead automatically unlocked after reaching a certain level.
Previously unlocked locations are refunded


Game now saves previous window position when relaunching
New hotkey: Press ‘R' to reset the window’s position and size to default
Added new customization options for pants and socks
Adjusted how hats are rendered (parts of hats can now appear behind hair)
Slightly adjusted some hats
Added 2 new hats
You can now refill bait in Equips menu when you’re at 0
Adjusted some upgrade prices
Adjusted drop rates of potions from the bird’s package
Quests are now grouped by location, and sorted by rarity
Reduced some lag when opening fish inventory with a lot of fish
Some other minor changes and improvements


Thanks for playing <3

notes.title: V1.7
notes.content:
Changes:

Updated engine to Godot 4.4.1
Added a new option for HD font
Changed one of the hair styles
Journal now opens automatically to your current location
Fixed a bug where quest notification dot wasn’t disappearing properly


<3

notes.title: v1.6
notes.content:
Some small changes:

Added new option to disable automatic bait swapping
Fish in quests popup now have colored names
Fixed a bug where tooltips sometimes went off the left side


Also, if anyone is having the issue where there is a black background/uninteractable UI, and you're willing to try a couple of things to help me to find the cause, please shoot me an email at foolsroomdev@gmail.com


Thanks for playing!

notes.title: v1.5
notes.content:
Bait is now automatically changed to a lower tier one when you run out
Adjusted some upgrade prices
Fish names are now colored based on their rarity
Added some new sorting options in fish inventory
Caught fish now say their size group when reeled in (“Big”, “Small”, etc.)
Changed Quest log text in top-right. Now shows quests remaining instead of quests completed.
Fixed a bug where Journal showed incorrect location
Fixed a bug where quest fish changed when reopening game
Fixed a bug where fish inventory wasn’t sorting properly when first opened


Thanks for playing <3

notes.title: New Options and Improvements
notes.content:
Some new things added:

Added new UI element to show current fish inventory capacity
Added new option to limit fps
Added new volume slider for UI sounds
Added new tooltips in options menu
Now checks certain achievement unlock conditions on game start
Fixed a bug where catching a fish with inventory open wouldn’t update the ‘sell all’ value
Some other small bug fixes and improvements


Happy fishing <3

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
A couple of little bug fixes:
- Fixed bug where you could refill bait even if you didn't have enough money
- Certain achievements not unlocking

Thank you for playing <3
